decisions.reason: Close to the firm's established bread line and present on the website for two years, its results likely meet historical aspirations, so problemistic search is not triggered.
As a sweet pastry close to the core confectionery offer, it likely performs at or above aspiration and is supported by organisational slack.
Though launched later, it is a core bread product with low uncertainty, and slack can support it while results are compared against similar bread lines.
Presented as a flagship, management treats it as a strategic focus and will likely maintain it even if seasonal results are uncertain, given slack and its directional role.
Its overlap with the flagship stollen creates some uncertainty relative to aspirations, but slack and its close-to-core seasonal nature make a near-term drop unlikely.
